name: econ-nlp-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for economics & NLP research workflows

plugins.name: agentic-clustering
plugins.description: Iterative agentic discovery of natural clusters in text corpora using a proposer/synthesizer/auditor/investigator/critic loop. Phase-2 classification is handled by the text-classification plugin, which this plugin declares as a dependency.

plugins.name: text-classification
plugins.description: LLM-driven text classification: apply a category set to a corpus via Claude or GPT with prompt caching, structured outputs, and async or batch execution. Interactive labelling + prompt tuning included. Usable standalone or as the phase-2 partner to agentic-clustering.
